title: Corrections to: "The Willmore flow of Hopf-tori in the 3-sphere"
claim_quote: p. 1, Abstract: "This erratum addresses a logical mistake in the author’s article [Jakob, R. The Willmore flow of Hopf-tori in the 3-sphere. Journal of Evolution Equations 23, No. 72 (2023)] which resulted in two wrong assertions in parts (II) and (III) of Theorem 1 in the author’s cited paper and in an inaccuracy in the formulation of the second part of Proposition 6 in that paper." p. 1: "However, the claimed threshold 8π²√2 has turned out to be too large and has to be decreased exactly to the number 4π²." p. 2: "Thirdly, in the second part of Proposition 6 of [6] one has to replace the interval (2π, 8π√2] by the disjoint union of intervals (2π, 4π) ∪ (4π, 8π√2]"; the note also states that the three mistakes were caused by one logical mistake and supplies revised theorems and a counterexample.
corrected_paper: The Willmore flow of Hopf-tori in the 3-sphere
rationale: correcció significativa / fora d'abast de patches (producte): cal canviar els enunciats II/III del Theorem 1, la definició de simple parametrization, els llindars d'energia i la Proposition 6, i el candidat afegeix teoremes revisats i un contraexemple; no és una correcció petita. El paper de Jakob no és cap document del repo.
